description: Open a local ESP-IDF project: a folder whose CMakeLists.txt includes ESP-IDF's project.cmake. The core remembers it (local.list) and returns it with its id, which then works wherever a library project id does: build.start builds it with idf.py (no consent: the user chose the folder), and sim.start, board.flash and circuit.* use the build. Opening it again returns the same id. Nothing is written to the folder.

id.description: local- and a hash of the folder's path; used as a project id by build.start, sim.start, board.flash and circuit.*.

name.description: From project(<name>) in the project's CMakeLists.txt.
